description: Live 100-company smoke test of the Signalpost agent against data.brreg.no, followed by an immediate second run on the same companies to check idempotent refresh.
how_it_was_run: The agent code in agent/ (brreg.ts, extract.ts, profile.ts, types.ts) was bundled with esbuild and run in a Chrome tab on data.brreg.no from the entrant's laptop, with node:crypto/fs/path replaced by browser equivalents (sha256, in-memory refresh state). Before the run, the bundle reproduced the Node build's output on the offline fixtures exactly (selfcheck digest 1a156e25824c80393773a88d5773594d0b6de75dde77d1fe7a51a26520d09e3c). The equivalent command-line run is: npx tsx agent/run.ts examples/smoke-100.txt out

sample.method: scripts/sample-batch.ts logic: random organisation form (weighted towards AS) and random founding month 1985-2024, then a random entity from that slice of Enhetsregisteret

integrity_checks_applied_to_every_envelo: exactly one envelope per input, in input order
every claim has at least one evidence record that exists in the envelope
every annual-accounts claim carries its reporting period
no registered employee count of zero is published
every available envelope has a legal name
